methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'We discover, develop, manufacture, and sell products in one significant business segment—pharmaceutical products.' (FY2009 10-K, Item 1); 'Our long-term success depends on intellectual property protection.' (FY2009 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'We depend on patent-protected products for most of our revenues, cash flows, and earnings, and we will lose effective intellectual property protection for many of them in the next several years.' (FY2009 10-K, Item 1A); 'Eight significant products, which together comprise 74 percent of our worldwide revenue' (FY2009 10-K, Item 1A); 'Loss of exclusivity typically results in a rapid and severe decline in sales.' (FY2009 10-K, Item 1A); 'Our product sales can be adversely affected by the introduction by competitors of branded products that are perceived as superior by the marketplace, by generic versions of our branded products, and by generic versions of other products in the same therapeutic class as our branded products.' (FY2009 10-K, Item 1A)

BEAR.desc: EPS -30.0%/yr (worst year FY00-FY09 ex-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.0%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY08 median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.0%/yr (FY00-FY09 ex-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +21.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY00-FY09 ex-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LLY (retrospective, 2010-04-01) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.10x (41.9% downside to Bear $21 / +400.7% upside to Bull $181) | Adj composite 3.23 vs market 1.10: gap +2.13 [UNDERVALUED] | -64% above the EPP floor $100 (21x FY10E $4.75) | Conservative 2-yr case: +317.0% total (+158.5%/yr) | At 7.6x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $48 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +11.0% in Q4 2009, forward revenues +11% (no FY10 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2009 total revenue growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
